assertions.name: mckay_marks_sum_to_coxeter_number_h_E8
assertions.source: The 2I irrep dims {1,2,3,4,5,6,4,2,3} are the affine E8-hat Coxeter marks; their sum is the Coxeter number h(E8)=30=P=2*3*5. Structural anchor of the McKay dictionary.

assertions.name: q1_value_anchor_dim_eq_mckay_mark
assertions.source: For each of the 4 bwS0 conjugation classes, dim(lambda) at q=1 equals the McKay mark of the corresponding A5-factoring node (1,4,5,6); the electron (3,1,1) dim 6 = A5 3+3' split. DERIVES the colour->lambda value at q=1 with no fit (McKay + A5 subset S5 branching, parameter-free).

assertions.name: value_map_eq_qint_mark_exact_unsplit_nodes
assertions.source: EXACT at generic q (machine-zero to 60 dps, both q0 and q=1.37): for the 3 unsplit A5-McKay nodes the Hecke q-dimension d_q(lambda) = [mark]_q exactly -- d_q((5))=[1]_q, d_q((4,1))=[4]_q (standard rep, #3640), d_q((3,2))=[5]_q (new). So the colour->lambda VALUE map is [mark]_q (the McKay Coxeter mark's q-integer), resolving the refuted [exponent]_q as an exponent-vs-mark mis-indexing. The split electron node (3,1,1) is d_q=[5]_q+1=d_q((3,2))+1 (the A5 3+3' split signature), not [6]_q. No fit.

description: Geometric W_lambda derivation: the colour->partition-lambda value-map DICTIONARY via the McKay correspondence 2I<->affine E8-hat (irrep dims = Coxeter marks; sum marks=30=h(E8)=P, sum dim^2=120=|2I|) composed with A5 subset S5 branching. The 4 bwS0 conjugation classes {lambda,lambda'} map explicitly to the 4 A5-factoring McKay nodes (marks 1,4,5,6), the electron block (3,1,1) being the A5 3+3'=6 SPLIT node and the muon block (3,2) the mark-5 node. q=1 value anchor DERIVED: dim(lambda)=McKay mark. Diagnoses the prior [e]_q refutation (keystone_colored_sigma235_wrt) as exponent-vs-mark mis-indexing. No fit; single global normalizer D. The colored Lawrence-Rozansky amplitude and the archimedean q0-continuation residual are deferred/open.
